image_description: A silver-colored, metallic breastplate (cuirass) designed to mimic the anatomy of a muscular male torso, featuring defined pectorals, abdominals, and obliques. The armor has a highly reflective, polished surface with dark embossed or etched details accentuating the muscle definition. Leather-like straps with buckles are visible on the sides for attachment. The background is a plain, neutral white.
